stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS (fall 2024 entering class): applicants, admits and enrollees from the Education Data Portal; enrollment and student-faculty ratio from College Navigator. No public Common Data Set was found. College Navigator shows no SAT/ACT percentiles or submission rates; GPA, residency splits and international applicant counts are not available. Undergraduate enrollment is the IPEDS fall 2024 headcount (6,774) across Mercy's Westchester, Manhattan and Bronx sites.
